faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Quick answers if you already use Mealime, SuperCook, or another meal app.
faq.q1: How is LarderMind different from Mealime?
faq.a1: Mealime is a strong meal-plan and grocery workflow. LarderMind is pantry-first and chat-first: you talk to an AI that remembers preferences, plans from what you already have, and closes the loop into calendar, shopping list, and pantry.
faq.q2: How is it different from SuperCook?
faq.a2: SuperCook is great at “what can I make from these ingredients?” as a recipe finder. LarderMind covers that idea inside a full kitchen loop — ongoing pantry, weekly plan, shopping list, and cooking confirmation — not only one-shot recipe search.
faq.a3: Yes. Free includes pantry, shopping, calendar, and 50 AI messages per week. Upgrade anytime for a 7-day Pro trial — then higher AI and upload limits from $4.99/mo.
faq.a4: On the web, and on iOS and Android. Sign up free on the web to start; use the same kitchen across devices.

mealime.metaTitle: Mealime Alternative - Rebuild Your Week | LarderMind
mealime.metaDescription: Mealime shut down on Oct 21, 2026. LarderMind plans a week of dinners from your pantry or a photo of your fridge, with a shopping list of only what's missing. Free to try.
mealime.title: Rebuild your Mealime week in minutes
mealime.lead: Mealime shut down on Oct 21, 2026 and deleted users' plans with no export. LarderMind can plan your next week of dinners from what you already have.
mealime.ctaHint: Opens a free guest chat with a starter prompt. No sign-up needed to try it.
mealime.starterPrompt: I used Mealime. Plan 5 easy weeknight dinners for 2 from what I have:
mealime.whatBody: Mealime shut down on Oct 21, 2026. Users' meal plans were deleted and there was no way to export them. You can't get them back, but you can start a new week quickly.
mealime.bullet1: Plans a week of dinners from what's in your pantry and fridge. Type it in or snap a photo of your fridge.
mealime.bullet2: Makes a shopping list of only what's missing.
mealime.bullet3: Has recipes for the meals it plans.
mealime.bullet4: Works in English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German and Japanese.
mealime.bullet5: Free plan available. Pro is $4.99/mo or $39.99/yr, with a 7-day trial.
mealime.disclaimer: LarderMind is an independent product and is not affiliated with Mealime.
